proposal.reason: Main change is review-routing policy/automation behavior, owned by workflow: .github/scripts/review_automation.py adds typed reviewer-withdrawal fallback (withdraw_review_requests, pending_review_requests), patch-omission handling, and updated classification/routing freshness checks; .github/scripts/maintainer_approval.py aligns gate staleness rules to PR head/target. .github/workflows/review-routing.yml only adjusts when this review-routing workflow runs (skip title/body-only edits), which is workflow policy/orchestration rather than ci test execution.
